```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lessR)
library(readxl)
library(BSDA)
library(lsr)
library(dplyr)
library(RVAideMemoire)
butterflies <- read_excel("butterflies_pesticides.xlsx")
head(butterflies)
view(butterflies)

```
Q1. Normality test / Prueba de normalidad (10pts)
```{r}
test1 <- byf.shapiro(`Wing Length` ~ Group, data = butterflies)
test1
```
<br>
Q2. Equality of variances test / Prueba de igualdad de varianzas (10pts)
```{r}
test2 <- var.test(`Wing Length` ~ Group, data = butterflies)
test2
```
<br>
Q3. Statistical test / Prueba estadística (20pts)
```{r}
t.test(filter(butterflies, Group == "group1")$`Wing Length`, 
       filter(butterflies, Group == "group2")$`Wing Length`,
       alternative = "two.sided",
       mu = 0, 
       paired = FALSE, 
       var.equal = FALSE)
cohensD(`Wing Length` ~ Group, data= butterflies)
```
<br>
Q4. ggplot (20pts)

```{r}
ggplot(data = butterflies) +
  geom_boxplot(
    mapping = aes(x = Group, y = `Wing Length`, fill = Group)
  ) 
```
<br>
Q5. Summary paragraph / Párrafo de resumen (40pts) - Write one concise paragraph summarizing your research objective, methods, statistical results, and interpretation of the findings, including whether the observed difference is statistically significant and biologically meaningful.
- Escriba un párrafo conciso que resuma el objetivo de la investigación, los métodos utilizados, los resultados estadísticos y la interpretación de los hallazgos, incluyendo si la diferencia observada es estadísticamente significativa y tiene relevancia biológica.
```{r}
# We tested to see if there was a significant difference in wing lenght between group1 and group2. Using a two-tailed independent t-test to compare wing lenght measurementes from 80 total samples, there was found statistical difference between the groups (t(78) = 3.98, p = 0.0001721, ES=0.89). This indicates that Group 1 butterflies have significantly longer wings than Group 2 butterflies, suggesting that the conditions experienced by each group may influence the wings development.
```
